speechText: Start with x squared plus five x plus six equals zero. We want two numbers that multiply to six and add to five. Those numbers are two and three, so the quadratic factors into x plus two times x plus three. Now set each factor equal to zero. x plus three equals zero gives x equals negative three. x plus two equals zero gives x equals negative two. So the solutions are negative three and negative two.
